 The Chicago Board Options Exchange Volatility Index (VIX) fell to its lowest level in about a week.
 The CBOE Volatility Index dropped 3.87 points from the previous session to 16.97 .
 That was the lowest level in about a week, and the index measures expected market volatility over the next 30 days.

 See more mid- to long-term trend analysis The Cboe Volatility Index, or VIX, a gauge of volatility in U.S. equities, fell to its lowest level in about a week.
 Walter Bloomberg said on Nov. 4 that the VIX dropped 3.87 points from the previous session to 16.97.
 That marked its lowest level in about a week.
 The VIX measures expected market volatility over the next 30 days based on options prices tied to the S&P 500.
